scripts.build: pnpm data:build && pnpm --filter nusaindex build && pnpm --filter nusaindex-mcp build
scripts.check: pnpm data:build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/nusaindex/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/nusaindex/src/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/nusaindex/test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p site/src/examples/tsconfig.json && tsc -p site/src/lib/tsconfig.json && tsc -p site/src/pages/tsconfig.json
scripts.pkg:check: pnpm --filter nusaindex run pkg:check && pnpm --filter nusaindex-mcp run pkg:check
scripts.pack:local: pnpm build && pnpm --filter nusaindex --filter nusaindex-mcp exec pnpm pack
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm comments:check && pnpm version:check && pnpm data:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm go:vet && pnpm go:lint && pnpm go:test && pnpm build && pnpm site:examples && pnpm site:build && pnpm size && pnpm pkg:check && pnpm audit:deps && pnpm go:vuln
